_doc: Visual register (MASTER_PROMPT_FINAL §20). Every scene declares its location and mode: literal (real objects, data, interfaces as they are), schematic (simplified but faithful diagram) or metaphor (a stand-in image). Every metaphor is justified against a source claim, its misreadings are listed with a guard, and its status is set by the user at STOP 1. Measured data must sit on a frontal plate; a recorded user decision can waive this. Checked by scripts/audit.mjs and the metaphor-auditor agent.

data.claim: S1: hour, week, month estimates do not speed up with age
data.waiver: user decision (decisions.md): survey chart on an isometric billboard, labels on frontal plates; re-confirm under §20.4

data.claim: S1: the last decade feels faster with age, peak around 50, modest effect
data.waiver: user decision (decisions.md): survey chart on an isometric billboard, labels on frontal plates; re-confirm under §20.4

locationReuse.reason: through-line: the memory tray in the room returns as a short bridge between locations (STOP 1)
the routine loop of scene 9 opens into new roads in scene 12 (callback, STOP 1)

memory-tray.keyIdea: Looking back, we judge how long a period was by how many distinct memories it left.
memory-tray.sourceClaim: S2 (Bradburn, clarity of memory), S3 (Hammond, holiday paradox: retrospective judgement by memories)
mapping: a card in the tray = one distinct memory
pile height = how long the period feels in hindsight
bright card = a new impression
grey card = a routine day
memory-tray.whyNotLiteral: Memories have no visible form; a brain scan would claim a mechanism the sources do not state.
memory-tray.misreadRisk: Viewers may read the tray as a literal storage place or think memories are counted one by one.
memory-tray.guard: The tray is an office object in an everyday room, never inside a head. The voice says «по одной из версий» only in scene 8; scenes 1–7 are covered by scene 11 («все эти объяснения — гипотезы»).

calendar-pages.keyIdea: Years pass faster and faster in the feeling of the viewer.
calendar-pages.sourceClaim: S1: perceived speed of the last decade rises with age
mapping: a torn page = a year that passed
faster tearing = years feel faster
calendar-pages.whyNotLiteral: A felt speed has no direct image; a calendar is the common sign of passing time.
calendar-pages.misreadRisk: Tearing speed could be read as a measured rate.
calendar-pages.guard: No numbers on the pages; the measured values appear only on the survey chart in scenes 3–4.

memory-catalogue.keyIdea: New impressions leave more memories, so the period seems longer.
mapping: card = new impression
drawer filled = memory stored
filled column = amount of memories
memory-catalogue.whyNotLiteral: Same as memory-tray; a catalogue makes «more memories» countable at a glance.
memory-catalogue.misreadRisk: The catalogue may be read as a model of the brain.
memory-catalogue.guard: No head or brain shapes (the head cabinet was rejected by the user); the voice frames it as «по одной из версий».

mapping: tape length = felt length of the period
tape-measure.whyNotLiteral: Felt duration has no unit; a tape is the plain sign of «длинный».
tape-measure.misreadRisk: Tape ticks could be read as a scale with values.
tape-measure.guard: Ticks without numbers; the tape grows with the filled drawers, not with a value.

routine-loop.keyIdea: Identical days leave few traces and merge in memory.
routine-loop.sourceClaim: S4 (routine and temporal landmarks; secondhand, wording kept cautious)
mapping: ring road = the same route home → work → home
grey card on the ring = a day that left few traces
new roads = new routes and places
routine-loop.whyNotLiteral: Routine is a pattern over weeks; a loop shows repetition in one shot.
routine-loop.misreadRisk: The advice could be read as a promise that new routes lengthen life.
routine-loop.guard: The voice says «возможно, растянуть годы в памяти»; no time values on screen.

life-cake.keyIdea: Version 2: at ten a year is a tenth of life; with age this share shrinks.
mapping: whole cake = life lived so far
slice = one year
more slices = older age
life-cake.whyNotLiteral: A share of life is a ratio; a cake slice is the familiar picture of a share.
life-cake.misreadRisk: Candles could be counted as an exact age.
life-cake.guard: Slices change from 10 to 50 as the voice says; candles are capped and are decoration of the birthday context, not data.

film-frames.keyIdea: Version 3: a young brain takes in more images per day.
mapping: a film frame = an image taken in
more frames on the same strip length = more images per day
film-frames.whyNotLiteral: Image processing speed is not visible; a film strip makes «more pictures» comparable.
film-frames.misreadRisk: Exact frame counts (8 vs 4) could be read as a measured ratio.
film-frames.guard: The voice calls it a version; scene 11 states all explanations are hypotheses. Ratio is illustrative.

mapping: head-shaped cabinet = the brain
drawer = memory
head-cabinet.misreadRisk: Suggests a literal storage mechanism in the brain; the user found it unattractive.

_note_2026_11_13: Statuses «approved» reflect the storyboard approved at STOP 1 before this register existed; the metaphor audit (content/reviews/metaphors.md) lists changes that need the user's decision.
